name: Issue Tracker
description: Track bugs, feature requests, and support issues through to resolution.

columns.name: open
columns.label: Open
columns.description: Newly reported issues that have not been triaged.
columns.hint: Move here when a bug or request is first reported.

columns.name: triaged
columns.label: Triaged
columns.description: Issues reviewed, scoped, and accepted for work.
columns.hint: Move here once priority and scope are confirmed and the issue is ready to assign.

columns.name: in_progress
columns.label: In Progress
columns.description: Issues actively being fixed or implemented.
columns.hint: Move here when work begins on the fix or feature.

columns.name: resolved
columns.label: Resolved
columns.hint: Move here when the fix is deployed and confirmed by tests or the reporter.
